title: Vegetables, fruit, grains, herbs, spices, sweeteners and other plant pantry items
accepted_by: akane321 (owner), 2026-09-24: accepted on the implementation agent's acceptance review (all 29 high-risk links read, 39/40 on a fixed-seed sample, two fixes applied); not read entry by entry
notes: Confirmed WP3 policy: alternative flours do not inherit wheat flour; each follows its source ingredient because catalog flour denotes ordinary wheat flour and gluten safety is handled separately.
Confirmed WP3 policy: use group:allium for onion, garlic, shallot, leek, green onion and chive so one household exclusion can cover the allium family.
Confirmed WP3 policy: hot fresh chillies and chilli-based powders inherit chili_pepper; bell_pepper and black_pepper do not.
Confirmed WP3 policy: garlic_salt, onion_salt, celery_salt and seasoned_salt inherit salt because a household avoiding salt would avoid these blends.
Confirmed WP3 policy: individual berry varieties inherit berries.

Extract policy: almond, citrus, mint, coconut, rum, vanilla and other commercial flavour extracts may contain alcohol as a solvent; pandan extract evidence is a Southeast Asian grocery flavouring and is treated as non-alcoholic.

Packaged seasoning policy: use may_contain only where the catalog evidence or customary product directly supports meat or seafood; generic spice-only packets remain unlinked when composition is not evidenced.
accepted_by remains null until the package owner personally reads and accepts every drafted entry.

almond_extract.reason: Recipes use concentrated almond extract; natural versions derive almond flavour and commercial extracts may use alcohol solvent.

asian_seasoning.reason: The sole recipe gives only a generic Asian seasoning label, with no evidence of a particular meat, seafood or plant base.

bonito_flakes.reason: Dried bonito flakes are made from skipjack, a tuna species, and the catalog has tuna as the nearest fish family id.

pita_bread.reason: Whole and split pita breads are flatbread varieties under the bread family.

pizza_crust.reason: Prepared pizza crust and refrigerated pizza dough are baked or unbaked bread-dough forms.

plantain.reason: Green and ripe cooking plantains form a distinct fruit family from the catalog's dessert banana id.

plum.reason: Fresh whole, halved and chopped plums form a distinct fruit family.

pomegranate_seeds.reason: Pomegranate arils are a distinct fruit ingredient, but no whole-pomegranate parent id exists.

poppadam.reason: Packaged plain poppadams may use lentil, chickpea or other flour, so no single source parent is guaranteed.

poppy_seed.reason: Whole and ground poppy seeds form a distinct culinary seed ingredient without a broader catalog parent.

potato.reason: Whole, red, baking, cooked and sliced potatoes make this the root potato id.

potato_chip.reason: Crushed and whole potato chips are fried prepared products made directly from potato.

potato_starch.reason: Potato starch is the purified starch extracted from potato.

poultry_seasoning.reason: Poultry seasoning is a dry herb blend used on poultry and does not itself contain poultry meat.

powdered_sugar.reason: Powdered, confectioners' and icing sugar are finely milled varieties of sugar.

prod_tomatillo.reason: Tomatillo is a distinct husked fruit in the nightshade family, not a tomato variety.

prune.reason: Prunes are dried plums and also a named variety within generic dried fruit.

puff_pastry.reason: Frozen and fresh puff-pastry sheets are a prepared laminated dough without a generic pastry parent id.

pumpkin.reason: Whole, cubed and puréed pumpkin make this the root id for pumpkin-derived foods.

pumpkin_pie_spice.reason: Pumpkin pie spice is a dry spice blend used with pumpkin and contains no pumpkin itself.

quinoa.reason: Cooked and uncooked quinoa form a distinct pseudocereal family without a broader catalog parent.

radish.reason: Fresh sliced ordinary radishes make this the root id for radish forms.

radish_sprouts.reason: Radish sprouts are the edible young growth of radish plants and follow a radish exclusion.

raisin.reason: Ordinary and golden raisins are dried grapes and a named dried-fruit variety.

ramen.reason: Packaged ramen evidence includes chicken-flavoured packets as well as discarded or other flavours, so chicken is possible but not universal.

raspberry.reason: Fresh and frozen raspberries are a named berry variety under the confirmed berries policy.

red_cabbage.reason: Red and purple cabbage are colour varieties of cabbage.

red_onion.reason: Fresh red onion is a direct onion variety and inherits the confirmed allium ancestry.

rhubarb.reason: Fresh chopped rhubarb stalks form a distinct vegetable ingredient family.

rice.reason: Cooked and uncooked white, long-grain and instant rice make this the root rice id.

rice_cake.reason: Korean tteok and garae-tteok rice cakes are prepared principally from rice.

rice_flour.reason: Ordinary and glutinous rice flours are ground rice, not the catalog's ordinary wheat flour.

rice_noodles.reason: Rice vermicelli and fresh or dried rice noodles are prepared from rice.

rice_paper.reason: Spring-roll rice papers are rice-based, but the evidence also includes confectioners' wafer paper with variable starch.

roasted_red_pepper.reason: Prepared roasted red peppers are roasted forms of sweet red bell pepper.

rose_water.reason: Rose water is a concentrated floral flavouring and not plain water for household exclusions.

rosemary.reason: Fresh, dried and crushed rosemary form one standalone culinary herb family.

rotel.reason: Ro-Tel is explicitly canned diced tomatoes combined with green chillies, so both are defining ingredients.

rutabaga.reason: Fresh peeled, diced and grated rutabaga form a distinct root-vegetable family.

rye_flour.reason: Light or dark rye flour is ground rye rather than ordinary wheat flour, and no rye parent id exists.

saffron.reason: Whole saffron threads and crushed saffron form a standalone spice ingredient.

sage.reason: Fresh, dried, ground and rubbed sage make one standalone herb family.

salt.reason: Table, kosher and ordinary salt make this the root id for salt-based seasoning blends.

salt_and_pepper.reason: This combined seasoning always includes salt and usually ground black pepper, while some evidence specifies white pepper.

sauerkraut.reason: Sauerkraut is fermented shredded cabbage and follows a cabbage exclusion.

scotch_bonnet.reason: Scotch bonnet is a named very-hot chili-pepper variety.

seasoned_salt.reason: Seasoning salt and seasoned salt are salt-based blends under the confirmed salt policy.

seaweed.reason: Wakame, kim and generic dried seaweed make this the root family for seaweed varieties.

self_rising_flour.reason: Self-rising and self-raising flour are ordinary wheat flour premixed with leavening.

semolina_flour.reason: Semolina is coarse durum-wheat flour and therefore a direct wheat-flour variety.

sesame_seed.reason: Whole, toasted, crushed and ground sesame seeds form a standalone seed ingredient family.

shallot.reason: Fresh peeled, sliced and minced shallots are direct members of the confirmed allium group.

shirataki_noodles.reason: Shirataki are konjac noodles, but the catalog has neither a konjac nor generic noodle parent id.

snow_peas.reason: Fresh and frozen snow peas are an edible-pod variety of peas.

soba_noodles.reason: Soba commonly contains buckwheat, while commercial and yakisoba-style noodles may also be predominantly wheat.

somyeon.reason: The evidence explicitly identifies somyeon as a thin wheat-flour noodle, a pasta variety.

sorghum_flour.reason: Sorghum flour is ground sorghum rather than ordinary wheat flour, and no sorghum parent id exists.

spaghetti_squash.reason: Whole halved spaghetti squash is a named winter-squash variety.

spelt.reason: Whole spelt or wheat berries share this ancient-grain id, but no generic wheat parent exists.

spinach.reason: Fresh, baby and chopped spinach make a distinct leafy-vegetable family.

squash.reason: Acorn, winter and generic squash make this the root family for named squash varieties.

star_fruit.reason: Star-fruit slices are an explicitly named variety under the broad fruit id.

strawberry.reason: Fresh and frozen strawberries are a named berry variety under the confirmed berries policy.

sugar.reason: Granulated white sugar is the root id for the catalog's direct sugar varieties.

sugar_cane.reason: Fresh sugar-cane stalks naturally contain abundant sucrose, so a household excluding sugar would avoid chewing or infusing them.

sugar_snap_peas.reason: Sugar snap peas are an edible-pod pea variety; their name does not make them processed sugar.

sugar_substitute.reason: Splenda, stevia and other sugar substitutes are selected in place of sugar and must not inherit it.

sumac.reason: Ground sumac is a standalone tart spice without another catalog family id.

sun_dried_tomato.reason: Oil-packed and dry sun-dried tomatoes are dehydrated products made directly from tomato.

sweet_potato.reason: Sweet potato is a botanically distinct root vegetable and is not a variety of ordinary potato.

sweet_potato_noodles.reason: Korean glass noodles are made from sweet-potato starch and do not inherit ordinary potato.

swiss_chard.reason: Fresh chopped chard leaves form a distinct leafy-vegetable family.

syrup.reason: Unqualified syrup is the family root for named liquid sweetener syrups in the catalog.

szechwan_pepper.reason: Szechwan pepper is a numbing spice from Zanthoxylum, neither black peppercorn nor hot Capsicum chilli.

taco_seasoning.reason: Taco seasoning mixes commonly include chilli powder, although commercial and homemade blend formulas vary.

taco_shell.reason: A crisp taco shell is a prepared corn tortilla product and follows a corn exclusion.

tamarind.reason: Tamarind paste, pulp and powder share this standalone sour-fruit flavouring id.

tapioca_flour.reason: Tapioca flour or starch is extracted from cassava and is not ordinary wheat flour.

taro.reason: Fresh taro root is a distinct starchy vegetable without a broader catalog parent.

tarragon.reason: Fresh, dried and crushed tarragon leaves form one standalone herb family.

tater_tots.reason: Plain and onion-flavoured tater tots are formed products made principally from potato.

teff_flour.reason: Teff flour is ground teff rather than ordinary wheat flour, and no teff parent id exists.

thai_basil.reason: Thai, holy and sweet basil leaves in the evidence are named basil varieties.

thyme.reason: Fresh, dried, whole and crushed thyme form one standalone culinary herb family.

tomato.reason: Fresh plum, cherry and ordinary tomatoes make this the root id for tomato-derived products.

tomato_paste.reason: Concentrated tomato paste is made directly from cooked-down tomatoes.

tomato_puree.reason: Tomato purée and mash are processed directly from tomatoes.

tomato_sauce.reason: Canned and prepared tomato sauce is principally made from tomato.

tortilla.reason: The evidence explicitly alternates corn tortillas and wheat-flour tortillas, so either grain base is possible.

tortilla_chips.reason: Crushed and whole tortilla chips are fried or baked pieces made from tortillas.

turmeric.reason: Ground and powdered turmeric form a standalone rhizome spice family.

turnip.reason: Fresh peeled, sliced and cubed turnips form a distinct root-vegetable family.

ube.reason: Purple yam or ube is a distinct starchy tuber without a generic yam parent id.

udon_noodles.reason: Packaged udon are thick wheat noodles and a direct pasta variety.

vanilla_wafer.reason: Vanilla wafers are baked cookies with minor flavouring, not vanilla extract and not an alcohol-containing ingredient for exclusion.

water.reason: Plain measured water is the root liquid id for its frozen physical form.

water_chestnut.reason: Water chestnut is a crisp aquatic vegetable and is not plain water despite its name.

watercress.reason: Fresh trimmed watercress leaves form a distinct leafy-vegetable family.

watermelon.reason: Fresh cubed, sliced and diced watermelon make this the root watermelon-fruit id.

watermelon_rind.reason: Watermelon rind is the edible white outer portion cut directly from watermelon.

wheat_berries.reason: Wheat berries are whole cereal kernels and are unrelated to the fruit family called berries.

wheat_germ.reason: Wheat germ is the embryo fraction of wheat grain, but the catalog has no generic wheat parent id.

whole_wheat_flour.reason: Whole-wheat and whole-wheat pastry flour are direct varieties of ordinary wheat flour.

wild_rice.reason: Wild rice is the grain of aquatic Zizania grass rather than cultivated rice, so a rice exclusion does not automatically cover it.

wonton_wrapper.reason: Wonton, egg-roll, lumpia and spring-roll wrappers vary; some doughs contain egg while others are egg-free.

yeast.reason: Fresh, active dry, instant and rapid-rise yeast form one standalone leavening family.

yellow_squash.reason: Yellow and summer squash are direct varieties of the generic squash family.

zaatar.reason: Za'atar is a compound Middle Eastern spice mix without one dependable catalog ingredient parent.

zucchini.reason: Fresh zucchini or courgette is a summer-squash variety under the generic squash family.
